title: 7.10 Seasons
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Name the four seasons, the sun, rain and snow, and say that it is warm.
grammar_function: It is + season; It is warm; I see the sun / rain / snow.
prerequisite: 2.4 It is; 4.11 I see; 7.4 It is hot. and It is cold.
speaking_outcome: Say It is summer., It is warm. and I see snow.
